metadata.title: About — Nikita, Freelance Software Engineer
metadata.description: Tokyo-based freelance software engineer with 9 years of experience. Trilingual in English, Japanese, and Russian.

story.p1: I'm a software engineer based in Tokyo. I grew up in Russia, studied foreign languages in Kobe, and built my career with Japanese product teams.
story.p2: Nine years across web, backend, and infrastructure. Mostly TypeScript and Ruby on Rails. For data, I rely on PostgreSQL and GraphQL. I also manage AWS infrastructure and build mobile apps using React Native or SwiftUI.
story.p3: My work falls into two categories: building version one of a product, or modernizing older systems. Modernization usually means Rails-to-Next.js migrations or splitting monoliths. I also build LLM pipelines that survive production. This includes evaluation harnesses, hallucination observability, LLM-judge testing, and autonomous CI bots.

metadata.title: Projects — Things I Am Building and Have Built
metadata.description: A collection of software projects including language learning apps, developer tools, and client work. Built with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Swift, and more.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.description: Things I'm building and have built.

healthcareAi.title: Healthcare AI Platform
healthcareAi.description: Client platform generating regulated care documents with LLMs. I built the generation pipeline and the reliability layer around it: an LLM-as-judge evaluation harness on a stratified fixed case set, hallucination-rate observability wired to tracing, and resumable eval runs for unattended prompt A/B testing.

agentOps.title: Agent-Driven Delivery
agentOps.description: An automation layer where coding agents do real delivery work: CI bots for code-quality triage and backlog pickup, guarded so review agents cannot approve their own changes, plus a Slack agent that triages Sentry alerts with cross-repo code and issue search.

kanyomi.title: Kanyomi
kanyomi.description: A Korean reading app for Japanese speakers: short pieces at your level, explained through Japanese — particles as は/を, Sino-Korean words through their kanji cognates, endings through です・ます. The landing page is live and an LLM pipeline drafts, glosses, level-tags and QA-checks the stories; the app itself is still being built.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy — How Your Information Is Handled
metadata.description: How nerixim.dev handles your information. What the contact form collects, how analytics work, and which third-party services are used.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This site, nerixim.dev, is a personal portfolio operated by Nikita. Here's a straightforward summary of how your data is handled.

dataCollected.heading: What data is collected
dataCollected.content: The contact form collects your name, email address, and message. Nothing else is collected directly by this site.

dataUsed.heading: How data is used
dataUsed.content: When you submit the contact form, your message is delivered to a private notification channel so I can review it and reply. The data is not stored in a database, sold, or used for any purpose beyond handling your inquiry.

analytics.heading: Analytics
analytics.content: This site uses <vercelAnalytics>Vercel Analytics</vercelAnalytics> and <speedInsights>Vercel Speed Insights</speedInsights>. Both are privacy-friendly — they do not use cookies and only collect aggregated, anonymized data such as page views and performance metrics.

cookies.heading: Cookies & local storage
cookies.content: This site does not set any cookies. The only client-side storage used is localStorage to remember your theme preference (light or dark mode).

thirdParty.heading: Third-party services
thirdParty.content: The site is hosted on <vercel>Vercel</vercel>. The contact form uses <cloudflare>Cloudflare Turnstile</cloudflare> for spam protection and <slack>Slack</slack> for private delivery of form submissions. These services may process limited technical data (such as IP addresses) as part of normal operation.

contactSection.heading: Contact
contactSection.content: If you have questions about this policy, feel free to reach out via the <contactForm>contact form</contactForm>.
